# Home Environment Manager Beta 101 — detailed weather warning information

Built directly on validated Beta100, retaining every controller, PID, native
power, window, sleep, sensor and weather safety rule without modifications.

- Weather warning chips display the actual **event/type/headline** and a short
  **description** from their configured physical Home Assistant warning entities,
  replacing the previously generic friendly-name text.
- Clicking a warning opens HEM's existing compact, scrollable top-layer
  information popover listing **every native attribute** and the exact entity's
  current state. Nested provider data, severity, event timing and instructions
  are displayed where supplied by the native integration. The popup provides
  a direct link to that warning entity's Home Assistant more-info dialog.
- Exact entity IDs are used, without guessing from duplicated friendly names.
  Missing warning entities fall back to a safe read-only label. Text and nested
  JSON are escaped before rendering.
- Native warning attribute changes refresh the chip even if HEM's dashboard
  revision stays unchanged. All other existing compact responsive behavior
  and scroll stability remain untouched.
- Includes new Chromium checks for a simulated DWD-style Wesseling warning,
  nested attributes, HTML escaping, native more-info, live text updates,
  duplicate source names and mobile popovers, together with the full inherited
  Beta100 validation and prerelease packaging.

This UI change does not control any physical device.
